caption:
"We tried ads and it didn't work."

I hear this on almost every call. And nine times out of ten, the ads weren't the problem.

What usually happened:

→ Nothing was tracked, so nobody can say which part failed
→ Leads came in and nobody followed up past the first attempt
→ The landing page asked for a phone number before giving a single reason to hand one over
→ The campaign ran three weeks and got cut before it had data

That's not a failed channel. That's a failed setup.

The frustrating part is that the money was spent and the lesson wasn't learned, because nothing was measured. Same ads, same budget, different plumbing, and the result changes completely.

If you've been burned before, that's worth 20 minutes. Link in bio.
